abstract: BACKGROUND/PURPOSE: In the last 10 years, the ability to diagnose fetal tumors in the prenatal period has improved greatly because of technical advances in imaging. Early diagnosis and determination of tumor may affect prognosis. METHODS: The authors retrospectively reviewed the records of 1316 fetuses who underwent sonographic evaluation for congenital defects at University of California-San Francisco over a 6-year period. Of these, 16 had fetal tumors and were followed up at our institution. There were solid or predominantely solid with small cystic component masses in one of 3 locations: cervical, mediastinal, or abdominal. Excluded from our study were those fetuses with either sacrococcygeal teratoma, congenital cystic adenomatoid malformation of the lung, or ovarian cyst, because these defects have been extensively reviewed elsewhere. In addition, masses that were primarily cystic also were excluded. Data collected included diagnosis, gestational age at diagnosis and at delivery, mode of delivery, fetal and neonatal survival, and disease confirmation. RESULTS: Of the 16 fetuses, 4 had mediastinal tumors: 2 with pericardial teratomas (both of whom died in utero) and 2 with cardiac rhabdomyomas (1 died; the other presented tuberous sclerosis and is alive at 2 years of age). Four patients had cervical tumors (3 died; 1 survived and is alive and well), and 8 had abdominal tumors (3 with liver tumors, 4 with a left adrenal mass, and 1 with retroperitoneal teratoma). All eight patients with an abdominal tumor are alive and well. CONCLUSIONS: Fetal tumors are rare, and the prognosis seems to depend on their location and size. Although easier to detect, cervical and mediastinal tumors have a worse prognosis. Abdominal masses are more difficult to detect but have a better prognosis.
abstract_ja: 背景・目的：過去10年間で、画像技術の進歩により出生前の胎児腫瘍診断が大きく向上した。早期診断と腫瘍の特定は予後に影響しうる。方法：カリフォルニア大学サンフランシスコ校において、6年間に先天異常の評価のために超音波検査を受けた1316例の胎児の記録を後方視的に検討した。このうち16例に胎児腫瘍があり、当施設でフォローアップされた。対象は、頸部、縦隔、腹部のいずれかの部位に存在する充実性または充実優位で小さな嚢胞成分を伴う腫瘤であった。仙尾部奇形腫、先天性嚢胞性腺腫様奇形、卵巣嚢胞を伴う例は、これらの疾患が他で詳細に検討されているため除外した。主に嚢胞性の腫瘤も除外した。収集したデータは、診断、診断時と分娩時の在胎週数、分娩様式、胎児および新生児の生存、疾患の確定の有無である。結果：16例中4例が縦隔腫瘍であり、そのうち2例は心膜奇形腫（いずれも子宮内死亡）、2例は心臓横紋筋腫（1例死亡、もう1例は結節性硬化症を呈し2歳で生存）であった。頸部腫瘍は4例で、3例が死亡し、1例が生存して健康である。腹部腫瘍は8例で、3例が肝腫瘍、4例が左副腎腫瘤、1例が後腹膜奇形腫であった。腹部腫瘍の8例は全員生存し健康である。結論：胎児腫瘍はまれで、予後は部位と大きさに依存すると考えられる。頸部および縦隔腫瘍は検出が容易であるが予後不良である。腹部腫瘤は検出がより困難であるが、予後は良好である。
